about: docs/skin-pack.md section 3: what the overlay's loader (native/overlay/src/skin.rs) makes of a pack folder - a valid pack, each rule broken, and what is skipped or dropped with one note. Written by hand: no PowerShell loads a skin, so no generator makes it (tests/vectors/common.ps1, NvHandMade); cargo test in native/overlay runs it. Synthetic packs only, never a real one. A case's pack is `base` with `edit` laid on its JSON files key by key (null drops a key), `alsoMoods` copies of ready's atlas, `files` whole, then `drop` removed, in skins/<folder>/ (folder mini unless given). A file {"png": [w, h]} is a blank sheet of that size, {"bytes": n} n zero bytes, {"text": t} t itself, anything else its JSON. The answer: ok, the id, name, voice said, moods with an atlas, the face each of the seven wears, whether the default lines stand in, and the notes logged; or ok false and the error.
